paragraphs: Mentioned at the beginning of Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim, chapter 6; Yuchasin reads bar Tzeruya.[^1][^2]

notes.text: רפ״ו gives beginning of chapter 6, not end. וגרסת היוחסין is one phrase across the line break, not proof of truncation. No specific modern halakhah is supplied or independently checked.

Yuchasin is read contextually as Sefer Yuchasin; Tzeruya is Hyman’s attributed reading of that work, without a fresh collation. Tzardaya/Tzeruya are conventional vowels for distinct supplied forms. The title remains R', without importing catalog רבי.
